settings.title: Settings
settings.empty.heading: Settings
settings.empty.body: Languages, data retention and your plan.
settings.languages.heading: Languages
settings.languages.body: Tradepass shows your form, storefront messages and the messages you send applicants in each buyer's language. {count} languages are built in. Your store's published languages:
settings.languages.customized: {count, plural, one {# text changed} other {# texts changed}}
settings.retention.heading: Data retention
settings.retention.months: Delete rejected and withdrawn applications after
settings.retention.deleteFilesHelp: Files are stored in your Shopify Files. When this is on, Tradepass deletes them together with the application.
settings.retention.note: Approved applications are kept while the buyer exists. Activity history older than 2 years is removed automatically.
settings.plan.heading: Plan and billing
settings.plan.devStore: This is a development store, so every feature is free.
settings.danger.heading: Danger zone
settings.danger.body: Delete every application, buyer record, tier link, certificate record, form, rule and activity entry that Tradepass stores for this store. This can't be undone.
settings.danger.modalBody: All applications, buyer records, tiers, certificate records, forms, automation rules and activity history in Tradepass are deleted, and settings go back to defaults.
settings.danger.modalKeeps: Your Shopify companies, customers, markets, catalogs and files stay in Shopify. Your Tradepass plan stays the same.
settings.danger.mismatch: This doesn't match your store name.
settings.error.months: Choose one of the listed periods.
settings.texts.title: Change texts
settings.texts.body: Change the wording of the messages you send applicants and of the pages they open from them. Leave a box empty to use the built-in text, which is shown in grey. Storefront messages are changed on the Storefront page.
settings.texts.tooLong: This text is too long. Keep it under 2,000 characters.
settings.texts.invalid: This text has a mistake in its braces, or uses a placeholder that isn't available here.
settings.texts.resetAll: {count, plural, one {Reset # changed text to default} other {Reset # changed texts to default}}
settings.texts.resetBody: {count, plural, one {# changed text goes back to the built-in wording.} other {# changed texts go back to the built-in wording.}}
settings.assignment.heading: Tier assignment
settings.assignment.label: How buyers are put into their tier
settings.assignment.autoHelp: Tradepass adds the company location to the tier's market in Shopify and checks that it worked.
settings.assignment.assistedHelp: You make the change in Shopify from a checklist on the Tiers page, and Tradepass confirms it. Use this if automatic assignment doesn't work on your store.
settings.assignment.note: Changing this affects new approvals and tier changes only. Open checklist items stay on the Tiers page until you check them.
settings.activity.heading: Activity history
settings.activity.body: Download a CSV file of what Tradepass and your staff did: who, what, when and the result. It holds the latest {max} entries; entries older than 2 years are removed automatically.
settings.activity.locked: Activity export is available on the Pro plan.
settings.certificates.heading: Certificates
settings.certificates.expiringDays: Days before expiry to mark a certificate Expiring soon
settings.certificates.onExpiry.ask: Ask me what to do with the tax exemption
settings.certificates.onExpiry.askHelp: The certificate shows Keep or Remove under Wholesale buyers → Certificates.
settings.certificates.onExpiry.removeHel: The exemption the certificate backs is removed from the buyer's company locations, unless another valid certificate covers it.
settings.error.expiringDays: Enter a number of days from 1 to 365.
settings.applicants.bookingHelp: Any scheduling page, for example your calendar's booking link. Shown after applying and while the application is open.
settings.applicants.error.days: Enter a whole number in the allowed range.
settings.applicants.error.tags: Use up to 10 tags of up to 40 characters each.
settings.applicants.error.url: Use a full https:// link or a page of your store starting with /.
settings.applicants.error.whatsapp: Use a https://wa.me/… or https://api.whatsapp.com/… link.
settings.applicants.heading: Applicants and contact
settings.applicants.reapplyDays: Days before a rejected applicant can apply again
settings.applicants.reapplyDaysHelp: 0 means they can apply again at once. Otherwise the form and their status page tell them the date.
settings.applicants.removeOnPause: Remove these tags when a buyer is paused, and add them back on resume
settings.applicants.shoppingHelp: A page of your store, for example /collections/wholesale or your quick order page, or a full https link.
settings.applicants.staleDaysHelp: Slow answers send buyers elsewhere. Older applications are marked on Home and in the queue.
settings.applicants.tags: Customer tags to add on approval (optional)
settings.applicants.tagsHelp: Separate tags with commas, up to 10. Handy for your own segments, email marketing or theme rules.
settings.applicants.whatsappHelp: A wa.me or api.whatsapp.com link. When set, applicants see “Message us on WhatsApp” on the form, the status page and the update page.
settings.countries.body: Choose which countries wholesale buyers can apply from, based on their billing address. Applicants from other countries see a short message in the form before they fill everything in.
settings.countries.errorEmpty: Tick at least one country, or choose “Every country”.
settings.countries.heading: Who can apply
settings.countries.mode.all.help: Anyone can apply. Recommended unless there are places you can't ship to.
settings.countries.mode.allow.help: Applicants must have a billing address in one of the countries ticked below.
settings.countries.mode.block: Every country except the ones I choose
settings.countries.mode.block.help: Applicants with a billing address in a ticked country can't apply.
settings.countries.note: The list is ignored while “Every country” is selected. Existing applications and buyers aren't affected.
